items.caption:
Caffeine before bed: is 6 hours early enough?
In one small study, a 400 mg caffeine pill taken 6 hours before bed cut measured sleep by more than an hour, though the sleepers did not report feeling it. One study, one dose.

items.caption:
He watched his son sleep and found REM.
In Chicago, Eugene Aserinsky recorded his 8-year-old son asleep and saw fast eye movements. In 1953 he and Nathaniel Kleitman published REM sleep in Science.
